findings.text: the aggregate-held-row branch of _write_corrected_row is exercised by none of the four delivered cases, which each seed a per-run file through ledger.run_path, so the correction path for a row the aggregate still carries has no test asserting it writes and reads back corrected.

the recorded_merge assertions at :160, :164, :169 and :199 compare the command's output to the same run["merge"] the test hands in via --merge, so they echo their own input and hold for any value the code stores; the load-bearing citation check at :161 does read an independently captured head.

the done_when names a base arm run on all_debug, but both delivered arms ran on rigel after the all_debug pair was discarded for a full /tmp, so the literal partition the measure names was not used although the base/head delta itself is sound.
